species: HEK293T cells were co-transfected with the expression plasmids for Flag-STING and Myc-US2 or control. After 24 h of transfection, the cells were collected, and the lysates were immunoprecipitated using anti-Flag M2 Affinity Gel. The eluted samples were washed, resolved using SDS-PAGE, and stained with Coomassie brilliant blue. The Jingjie PTM BioLab (Hangzhou) Co. Inc. conducted an LC-MS/MS study ( Supplementary Table S2 ).
